objective: Close the independently reproduced A-B-A stale ReviewRequest reauthorization defect without weakening atomic admission.
required_change: Bind every review request to its issuance epoch/token inside SerializedReviewAdmission at request issuance; callers must not be able to pair an old request with a newly fetched snapshot epoch.

Prefer an owner-issued opaque ticket/nonce or an immutable issued-request object validated by the same owner. admit_and_dispatch must consume the bound token internally and must not accept a free caller-supplied current epoch for an arbitrary request.

Any active-run, authority, or exit-fence epoch change including A->B->A invalidates all earlier unconsumed tickets. Failed/deferred semantics must preserve latest-only policy without replaying unknown delivery.
Update the scheduler to issue and retain the owner-bound ticket, not a bare ReviewRequest. Remove or fail-close legacy call shapes that reintroduce arbitrary epoch pairing.
Make the independent failing A-B-A test pass and add forgery/other-owner/stale-ticket/exactly-once focused coverage.
verification: Run observation and relevant workflow/bridge/contracts/G4 regressions.
Rerun actual OMP only if production probe call shape changes; otherwise explain reuse.
constraints: apply_patch only; no workflow record edits, uv/local env/package artifacts, commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean, or graphify restore.
